bible_verses.english: “Can’t I do with you, house of Israel, just as this potter does?” says Yahweh. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.”
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I yield my heart to You today, just as clay in the hands of the Potter. Soften the hard places in my spirit and reshape me according to Your loving wisdom. Forgive me for trying to control my own transformation, and help me simply abide in Your presence. Mold my desires, thoughts, and actions so that I may reflect Your grace and truth to the world around me. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we come before God with open hands, we invite the ultimate Creator to reshape our inner world. Like clay in the hands of a loving Potter, our lives are safest when yielded to His gentle, transformative touch. Asking Him to change our heart isn't about striving on our own strength, but surrendering to the One who makes all things new. As you worship today, let go of the pressure to fix yourself and simply trust Him to mold you into the image of Jesus.
